ticket: Data releases that only add rows go live on passing checks, only data_reason changes stay in the daily batch
title: Releases wait for the Founder only when they must: an incomplete look is asked again, adding rows no longer holds, the review email tells the truth
why: Jason's ruling 1, confirmed 2026-11-28 14:10 UTC through the session manager: "I shouldnt" be required to review these. Gate: every launch gate's releases pass through this pipeline (0181 §1), and three of today's releases (#331, #332, #333) stopped on the check's own sign-in, not on the release.

changes.what: When the before-and-after check can't judge a release (the test accounts couldn't sign in), the site asks for the look again, three looks in all, each known by its run. Only if the third look still can't judge it does it reach the Founder: the release stays on staging, unpublished, his email says it couldn't be judged and why (never "its checks passed"), and an Audit ticket goes to the IT Manager's lane with the report's link. A look that passes or blocks is acted on as before. A release never goes live unchecked.

A migration that only adds rows no longer keeps a release in the daily batch. One that changes or removes rows (UPDATE or DELETE, the ones with a data_reason) still waits for the Founder, and a high-risk territory still stops first as a Decision Brief.

The "waiting for your review" email says "its checks passed" only when the before-and-after check passed. For a look that couldn't be judged it says so, with the three tries, and for any release it says why it waits for the Founder.

When the day's check minutes are spent, no new look is asked for and nobody is emailed. A release waits on staging, unpublished, until the minutes reset at 00:00 UTC, then it is looked at and published as any other. The Releases page says why it waits and when it resumes. A release whose look already passed publishes as normal.

tier4: The release pipeline's own rules (Releases, BeforeAfter, ReleaseKind): the Founder's ruling 1, 2026-11-28. No money, security, private-data or 0066 check is changed
